bypass.title: Allow Azure services
bypass.description: Let trusted Microsoft services, like backups and monitoring, reach the storage account even though other access is restricted. Most people can leave this as is.

ip_rules.title: Allowed IP addresses
ip_rules.description: The internet addresses allowed to reach the storage account. Add one per line, e.g. 203.0.113.7 for a single address or 203.0.113.0/24 for a range. Ask your platform team if you're not sure what to enter.
